svg.title: Haat: an export desk run by AI agents, settled by PayPal
svg.desc: A Hindi voice note from a block printer in Bagru becomes an English export listing, is published to the PayPal catalogue, is paid for, and the money is split between the makers by UPI.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
